scenes.headline: How a coding assistant splits work between laptop and cloud
scenes.sub: Microsoft's Windows release of 7 October, read part by part.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Router! Microsoft is putting a coding model on your laptop. Here's how the pieces fit.

scenes.text: A connected service picks, per request, whether your laptop's GPU or a hosted model answers. Tool calls run in a sandbox either way.
scenes.say: A cloud service picks, per request, whether your laptop or a hosted model answers. Commands run in a sandbox either way.

steps.say: The app, the command line and the editor share one agent on your machine.
Auto selection lives in the cloud. Work that needs more capability goes to a hosted model.
Eligible work goes to a local server instead: llama.cpp on the graphics chip.
Either way, its shell commands run inside an operating system sandbox.

scenes.title: llama.cpp inside Windows ML
scenes.say: The local server can come from Windows ML.

items.say: The file extension picks the backend. GGUF files go to llama.cpp.
Stock llama.cpp, not a fork. The graphics backend you build yourself.
A loopback server, with a fresh key each start.

scenes.title: How big is the local model?

parts.say: A hundred and thirty-seven billion parameters, under seven billion active per token.
About three point three bits per weight.
Fifty-three gigabytes, seventy-five and a half at peak. You want the 128 gigabyte machine.

steps.say: The demo video says twenty-two gigabytes instead.
That would be about one point three bits per weight. The engineering numbers are the ones that add up.

scenes.title: Time to read a full context
scenes.say: Reading context is the slow part: about seventy seconds for sixty-four K tokens, nearly three minutes for twice that.

scenes.text: A local model moves token generation onto your GPU. The routing, the telemetry and the session stay connected.
scenes.say: A local model moves token generation onto your laptop. Routing, telemetry and the session stay connected.

recap: A cloud router picks local or hosted
Stock llama.cpp runs the local model
Tools run in a sandbox either way
scenes.say: Cloud router, local llama.cpp, sandboxed tools.
